echam.base_version: echam-6.3.02p4 (MPI svn r4310) / HAM2.3 / MOZ1.0, tree echam6.3.0-ham2.3-moz1.0.r7492
routines: vdiff.f90::vdiff statements: constants (l.564-573), full-level thermodynamics and saturation loop (l.658-682), half-level averaging loop (l.684-700), buoyancy / shear / Richardson-number block (l.777-799)

harness.location: not in the repository (own code, built from a local ECHAM6.3 tree at build time)
harness.stub_note: Stubs declare names that routines this harness never calls read (run switches, I/O, clock); none holds a number the compiled statements use, except time_step_len = delta_time = 720 s for the surface cells' pressure-scaled coefficients, which the Richardson numbers do not read.

variants.echam_tables: ECHAM as it runs: the spline lookup tables of mo_echam_convect_tables.f90 (arrays echam_*)
variants.analytic_tables: the same statements with the tables replaced by the Sonntag (1990) fit they tabulate (harness module sat_analytic_tables.f90, -DSAT_SONNTAG; arrays echam_analytic_*)

optimisation_independence: the -O2 and -O0 builds (both variants) give bit-identical arrays

model_states.configuration: t63-echam-1m, init=from_state sonntag-spin1m.ckpt (30 sim-days of spin-up), 1 simulated day on CPU, instantaneous fields every 0.25 d (output_averages=false)
model_states.selection: seed 962; 10 columns per class per snapshot: bl_unstable, bl_stable, cloudy, saturated, melting_crossing, cold, low_cloud, random (320); plus 64 designed columns
model_states.surface_cells: 96: the 48 lowest-level cells with cover > 0 and 48 with cover = 0, skin temperature within [-6, +8] K of the air (land), [-4, +6] (water), <= 272 K (ice)
